newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-KIPTANUI MAKES CONFIDENT START TO TITLE DEFENCE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-KIPTANUI MAKES CONFIDENT START TO TITLE DEFENCE.

text.p: Wworld record holder Moses Kiptanui started his bid for a fourth world title by qualifying comfortably on Sunday for the semifinals of the 3,000 metres steeplechase.

Kiptanui, silver medallist at last year's Atlanta Olympics, slowed down at the end of his first round heat to finish third. The Kenyan clocked eight minutes 25.80 seconds behind Polish winner Rafal Wojcik who ran 8:24.93.
Italy's Olympic bronze medallist Alessandro Lambruschini also went through from the heat, finishing sixth in 8:26.35.
